_comment: Encoded design factors: what a descriptor value implies for making. Edit here, not in code.
_status: PROVISIONAL. Drawn from Study 1 site experience and general handling/fabrication practice. Not verified with domain experts. Every derived output carries data_status 'proposed'.
_circularity_note: Thresholds were informed by Study 1. Agreement between derived outputs and Study 1 decisions is therefore expected and is NOT validation.

handling_class.basis: Manual-handling guidance for single and team lifts; Study 1 site practice.
handling_class.max_dim_note: Above this longest dimension, a fragment is machine-handled regardless of mass (awkward to grip, unsafe to carry).

connection_strategy.basis: Study 1 timber-to-concrete connections; drilling avoidance where reinforcement is exposed.

rules.note: face not captured by the scan; geometry unverified
flat, large enough to seat a fixing plate
too rough or too small for a fixing

design_assignment.basis: Study 1 spolia principle: cast and finished faces exposed, fracture faces seated or buried.

rules.note: flat fracture face, suitable for bearing

use_suggestions.basis: Study 1 urban-furniture programme: seating, table surfaces, leaning supports, stable bases.
use_suggestions._how_to_read: Each entry combines conditions on one face with conditions on the whole fragment. A suggestion is offered when at least one face satisfies requires_face and the fragment satisfies requires_fragment. Thickness = smallest oriented-bounding-box dimension.

rules.label: Bench or table top
rules.note: flat, smooth cast face large enough to sit at or place objects on; thick enough to span

rules.label: Seat surface
rules.note: smaller flat face, fragment heavy enough to stay put under use

rules.label: Leaning or backrest surface
rules.note: large face, mass resists displacement. Resting-pose orientation is not computed, so the angle the face presents once placed is unverified

rules.label: Stable base or footing
rules.note: broad bearing face and high mass; supports elements placed on top

rules.label: Exposed face, material history visible
rules.note: carries visible traces of the fragment's former life; candidate to face outward
